mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profiles ( user_id, profile_vector, window_size, query_count, click_count, favorite_count, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{profileVector}, #{windowSize}, #{queryCount}, #{clickCount}, #{favoriteCount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE profile_vector = VALUES(profile_vector), window_size = VALUES(window_size), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE user_profiles SET query_count = #{queryCount}, click_count = #{clickCount}, favorite_count = #{favoriteCount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_profiles SET profile_vector = #{profileVector}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
